packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch + minor for everything except UI majors. Patch is safe by definition; minor is library-author-promised-non-breaking.
Group all Go indirect deps into one PR each cycle — they're rarely user-visible and reduce review churn.
Group GitHub Actions digest updates together — pinDigests creates a lot of tiny PRs otherwise.
Major bumps for our charmbracelet TUI stack travel together (bubbletea + lipgloss).
tailwindcss + tailwind-merge move together; the merge package's API tracks tailwind majors.
vite + plugin-react move together; the plugin's compatibility table tracks vite majors.
Scanner-image base bumps need a coordinated rebuild of all 4 bucket images plus the main wolf Dockerfile. Keep them in one PR.
